The Sinking City 2 emerges from the depths and onto PS5 on August 18th, 2026! Pre-orders are available now. 

Explore the flooded city of Arkham in this Lovecraftian survival horror as you search for a way to undo the effects of a dreaming ritual gone wrong that has left your soulmate trapped between our world and a world of unfathomable monsters.

Experience a heart-pounding survival horror as you explore the festering city of Arkham and fight eldritch monsters beyond human comprehension.
